children.value: > Fact From Story The pricing structure for 2024 represents an enormous increase over the 2023 costs.

> > Fact From Story Meanwhile, a season ticket in the lower-level midfield club area, which includes upscale food and beverage options, cost $3,600 in 2023 but will now run $7,650 for the 2024 season, an increase of 113%, more than doubling year-over-year.
> > Fact From Story The cheapest season ticket in 2023 was $485, but that will jump all the way to $884, which is an increase of 78.8%.
> > > Fact From Story There is a discount for fans who renew by October 7.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Discounts incentivize earlier renewal.
> > Commonsense Knowledge 78.8% and 113% are both enormous increases.
> Commonsense Knowledge A large increase in price is a huge margin over previous pricing.
